predecessors.name: Duchy of Saxe-Gotha-Altenburg
predecessors.text: Meiningen and its district, partitioned from Saxe-Gotha among the sons of Duke Ernest I ('Established in 1681'; infobox 'Partitioned from Saxe-Gotha: 1680')

successors.name: Weimar Republic
successors.text: the state as it stood in 1870, unchanged to November 1918 (Free State of Saxe-Meiningen)

ledger.x: 1680: Bernhard I founds the Saxe-Meiningen line at Meiningen.
1729: Meiningen acquires the Schaumberg half of the Amt Schalkau.
ledger.cp: Schaumberg noble family (holders of half the Amt Schalkau; no dossier)

ledger.x: 1735: Meiningen receives the Amt Neuhaus and the Gericht Sonneberg from the Coburg inheritance.
1753: two thirds of the Herrschaft Römhild are awarded to Meiningen.
ledger.cp: Herrschaft Römhild (previous holder not named by the page; no dossier)

ledger.x: 12 November 1826: Saalfeld, Gräfenthal and Themar pass from Coburg-Saalfeld to Meiningen.
12 November 1826: Kranichfeld and the last third of Römhild pass from Gotha-Altenburg to Meiningen.
12 November 1826: the County of Camburg passes to Meiningen.
1826: Callenberg and Gauerstadt go to Coburg.

8 October 1866: the peace with Prussia requires 'die endgültige Abtretung des umstrittenen Dorfes Abtlöbnitz bei Camburg' (the page does not name the recipient; Prussia by context, and the German Abtlöbnitz page says Meiningen 'transferred its sovereignty rights to Prussia', the village then belonging to the Kreis…
November 1918: the duchy ends in the German Revolution.

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War
wars.outcome: Bernhard II 'had backed Austria'; after the defeat 'Bismarck enforced his abdication in favour of his son' George II (20 September 1866 per the German page) and Saxe-Meiningen joined the North German Confederation; the peace of 8 October 1866 required the…

certainty.note: A small Ernestine duchy of scattered districts; only an area (about 970 km2) is known from the pages opened.
Boundaries of the partition of 12 November 1826 and the Kreise of 1868; the exclaves of Camburg and Kranichfeld lie apart from the main body.
